name_zh: 巴切莱特/智利/女性/医生/社会/养老金/米歇尔/温和/改革
description_zh: 米歇尔·巴切莱特 (1951-) 智利总统 (2006-2010, 2014-2018) 第一位女总统，医生出身，推行社会福利改革，特别是在养老金制度方面，被誉为"社会总统"，代表了温和改革和共识政治。
description_en: Michelle Bachelet (1951-) Chilean President (2006-2010, 2014-2018) first female president, doctor by profession, implemented social welfare reforms, especially in pension system, known as "social president", represents moderate reform and consensus politics.
reason_zh: 巴切莱特代表了拉美如何通过温和改革和共识政治推动社会福利，特别是在养老金制度方面，以及如何通过女性领导力实现社会转型。
reason_en: Bachelet represents how Latin American promotes social welfare through moderate reform and consensus politics, especially in pension system, and how female leadership achieves social transformation.
